article_only_videos.title: Twitter Gravel V3
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by Twitter Bike USA; the description promotes a purchase link. This is seller-produced promotional footage.
article_only_videos.summary: A 2025 seller overview of a Twitter Gravel V3. The exact frame revision and component package are not established; this footage does not verify the catalog's T47 builds, clearance, weight or mainland China prices.

article_only_videos.title: We Built a Completely Custom Yoeleo Altera G21 Gravel Bike
article_only_videos.disclosure: Produced by Crafted Cycles, a bike retailer and workshop; its description promotes its own custom-build and fitting services. This is commercial workshop context, not an independent product test.
article_only_videos.summary: A custom-painted Altera G21 workshop build with Rival XPLR, DT Swiss G1800 wheels and a separate bar and stem. The mechanics discuss the customer's component choices, cockpit setup and tyre preparation; this is not a stock complete-bike configuration.

takeaways.text: This customer's build pairs SRAM Rival XPLR with DT Swiss G1800 wheels and separate Zipp bars and stem. Those choices do not describe a standard Yoeleo complete-bike trim.
The mechanic values the separate stem because it leaves room for later cockpit adjustments. The position shown belongs to this customer, rather than a fit recommendation for every G21 buyer.
They discuss bar reach and lever shape together before finalising the hood position and hose lengths. Swapping a groupset can change more than the shifting controls.

Before a remote trip, they suggest practising removal of the actual tyre and rim combination at home. An easy workshop installation is not a guarantee that every combination will be equally manageable.

article_only_videos.title: Is THIS The Best Value Race Bike EVER? Elves Falath EXP Custom Build
article_only_videos.disclosure: Produced by Crafted Cycles, a bike retailer and workshop; its description promotes its own custom-build and fitting services. This is commercial workshop context, not an independent product test.
article_only_videos.summary: A July 2025 Falath EXP workshop build using mechanical Shimano 105 and clincher tyres with tubes. The retailer explains the component choices behind its value claim; historical bundle amounts and comparisons are not current prices or independent performance evidence.

takeaways.text: The shop combines the Falath EXP frame, one-piece cockpit and carbon wheels in this build. Its historical bundle discussion is not a current quote for another market or configuration.
Mechanical12-speed Shimano 105 is a deliberate budget choice for this customer. The video does not measure a performance difference against an otherwise identical electronic build.
This build uses GP5000 clincher tyres with inner tubes. The retailer discusses its own setup costs; that does not establish the lifetime cost of tubes versus tubeless for every rider.
Saddle choice, bar width and stem length are specified for the customer before assembly. The frame and groupset names alone do not tell you whether the finished bike will suit you.

article_only_videos.title: The ULTIMATE BUDGET Race Bike? ELVES Falath EXP Custom Build For @TriathlonDan
article_only_videos.disclosure: Produced by Crafted Cycles, a bike retailer and workshop; its description promotes its own custom-build and fitting services. This is commercial workshop context, not an independent product test.
article_only_videos.summary: Crafted Cycles' June 2025 Falath EXP customer build illustrates choosing contact points, wheels and gearing before assembly. It is a retailer's presentation of one rider's specification, not a current Elves package or an independent aero or fit test.

takeaways.text: The customer specifies the cockpit width and stem length instead of accepting the frame size's usual finishing kit. Those dimensions reflect one rider's preferences, not a sizing rule.
The customer keeps a saddle already familiar from another bike. A new frameset does not require changing every contact point at once.
The wheels, gearing and crank length are chosen for this particular rider. Their presence in the video does not make them a standard Falath EXP package or proof of compatibility for another build.

article_only_videos.title: The TOP 5 Tools Every Home Bike Mechanic Needs!
article_only_videos.disclosure: Produced by Crafted Cycles, a bike retailer and workshop; its description promotes its own custom-build and fitting services. This is commercial workshop context, not an independent product test.
article_only_videos.summary: A workshop mechanic's selection of tools for recurring home maintenance. It helps distinguish everyday tasks from specialist work; the video's broad savings and chain-lubrication claims are opinions, not measured results or a universal shopping list.

takeaways.text: The mechanic starts with a stable repair stand and well-fitting hex keys, focusing on tools used repeatedly rather than a complete professional workshop.
He distinguishes smaller and larger torque-wrench ranges for different jobs. A tool's range is not the tightening setting: use the exact component maker's instructions.
Chain pliers and a chain tool are presented as recurring-maintenance tools. Check their compatibility with the actual chain and its maker's replacement and joining procedure.
A waxing station is his fifth preference. The video does not provide a controlled cost, wear or efficiency comparison that would make it a necessary purchase for every home mechanic.

article_only_videos.title: Was Chain Waxing Worth the Hassle?
article_only_videos.disclosure: The presenter says this video is unsponsored and the products were bought with his own money. The description contains equipment affiliate links; the closing remarks mention a SILCA discount for Patreon supporters and say he receives no payment from those purchases. These are his disclosures, not an independent financial audit.
article_only_videos.summary: A July 2022 personal follow-up on immersion waxing and drip-wax upkeep. It illustrates one rider's workload and preferences; it does not establish a controlled wear advantage, universal maintenance interval or financial payback.

takeaways.text: The presenter says the initial time and equipment investment will not suit everybody; convenience can make an ordinary drip lubricant a better personal choice.
He says he has not tracked enough comparable use to conclude that the waxed chains are wearing more slowly. His favourable experience is not a controlled durability result.
He flags drying and follow-up care after wet rides as an important part of his routine. His largely semi-arid riding context does not establish a universal wet-weather schedule.

article_only_videos.title: How to Remove and Install a Bicycle Tire & Tube
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by bicycle-tool maker Park Tool. The demonstration uses its products and the description links to its tools and repair resources. This is manufacturer education, not an independent tool comparison.
article_only_videos.summary: A July 2016 demonstration of tyre and inner-tube removal, inspection and installation. Use it to discuss the repair with your assembler; current instructions for the exact wheel, tyre and tube govern compatibility and technique.

takeaways.text: The presenter inspects the tyre, tube and rim to understand why the flat occurred before fitting a replacement. A spare alone does not resolve an unidentified cause.
The demonstration checks the rim strip and exposed spoke-related damage as well as the tyre. Damage at the wheel can matter even when the replacement tube is intact.

The presenter checks tyre seating and looks for a trapped tube before completing inflation. Follow the current limits and procedure for your exact components; this older demonstration does not approve a modern hookless or TPU setup.

article_only_videos.title: 5 Things I Wish I Knew as a  Beginner Gravel Cyclist
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by CADE Media. The description lists companies supporting the channel financially or with products, including tyre brands, and includes affiliate and discount links. The exact commercial arrangement for the demonstrated equipment is not established.
article_only_videos.summary: An April 2022 beginner discussion of gravel surfaces and tyre choices. Its route examples help frame a buying question; they are not controlled tyre tests or approval to copy the advanced riding shown.

takeaways.text: The presenter explains that a ride called gravel can include very different surfaces. Identify the actual route rather than buying tyres from the category name alone.
He contrasts hard-packed paths with muddy tracks when discussing tyre choice. This is qualitative riding context, not measured grip, rolling-resistance or pressure data.

article_only_videos.title: Does a Gravel Bike work as a Road Bike?
article_only_videos.disclosure: The description says the channel is supported by Saddleback and links to branded riding equipment. It does not establish whether the Scott bicycle or wheelsets were provided for this video.
article_only_videos.summary: A December 2022 road ride on a Scott Addict Gravel with a changed wheel-and-tyre package. It illustrates one rider's road-use experience and gearing discussion, not a controlled speed-equivalence result for every gravel frame.

takeaways.text: The presenter changes both wheels and tyres on the Scott Addict Gravel for road use. This is a package change, not an isolated tyre-only experiment.
On his local roads he describes the slick-equipped bike as feeling closer to an endurance road bike than a race bike. That is his impression of the shown setup, not a universal handling result.
His shown setup uses a two-by drivetrain, and he discusses cadence steps and usable gearing for his rides. A second wheelset does not by itself resolve every gearing or position requirement.

article_only_videos.title: Are Expensive Carbon Wheels Worth it?
article_only_videos.disclosure: The description contains a Stages discount, product links and a statement that Performance Bike supports the channel. It does not establish the commercial arrangement for the particular wheelsets compared.
article_only_videos.summary: A September 2022 outdoor wheelset comparison. Its stated protocol and the presenter's own limitations help evaluate review evidence; the ride and crosswind comments remain his experience of the samples shown.

takeaways.text: The presenter describes four outdoor runs with the same bicycle, tyres and tubes, changing wheelsets in a staggered order. This is his field-test protocol, not a wind-tunnel certification.
After showing steady-power run results, he says the protocol is not a race simulation and proposes a different test. Interpret the reported result within the conditions actually tested.
He separates subjective road-feel and crosswind impressions from the run data. Those impressions concern this rider, equipment and conditions, not every rider or a whole brand's current range.

article_only_videos.title: Testing Cheap Carbon Handlebars To Failure
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by Berm Peak Express. The presenter says the video is not sponsored by PNW, whose bars he praises; the description promotes his own book, clothing and paid early-access posts. How each tested sample was obtained is not documented.
article_only_videos.summary: A September 2026 home-workshop load test of single samples of low-cost carbon, branded carbon and aluminium handlebars. The presenter separates his static rig from ISO testing; results describe the samples shown, not every bar of a brand or seller.

takeaways.text: The rig pulls both bar ends through a stem with a winch and reads the force on a crane scale. The presenter says it is not an exact ISO procedure and later stresses that it applies a static load, not an impact test.

With one sample of each, the low-cost carbon bars failed at centre loads he read as roughly 600–1,000 lb, mostly between the grip area and the centre. The branded aluminium and carbon reference bars reached his 1,200 lb winch limit without breaking.

A cheap bar printed with a major component brand lacked markings he expected, and he treats it as probably counterfeit; it cracked well below the strongest cheap bars. A familiar logo on a part is not evidence of that brand's testing.

His conclusion is that one result cannot show consistency: repeated testing is what should make every unit fail predictably. New samples also could not show how scratches or impact damage would change the failure point.

article_only_videos.title: Why is Eagle Transmission such a big freaking deal?
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by Berm Peak Express. The description says the presenter is a part owner of the valve company Clik, links to the featured SRAM drivetrain and promotes his own merchandise and paid early-access posts. How the drivetrain was obtained is not stated.
article_only_videos.summary: A July 2023 mountain-bike explainer of the conventional derailleur hanger, the UDH interface and SRAM's hangerless direct-mount Transmission derailleur. It explains the concept; it is not fit approval for road or gravel frames.

takeaways.text: On an older frame with a fixed hanger, he shows how a crash bends it and how repeated straightening can break it. Replaceable hangers became common because they bend or break instead of the frame.
The Transmission derailleur looks frame-mounted, but he explains that it sits where the UDH would be and is held by the thru-axle, so there is no separate hanger left to bend.
He describes UDH as a common hanger that also standardised the frame's rear interface; that shared interface is what lets one direct-mount derailleur fit those frames without a frame-specific hanger.
He calls installation easy once learned but sensitive to tight tolerances: cassette and thru-axle need a torque wrench, which in his words replaces the hanger alignment gauge in the home toolkit.

article_only_videos.title: Proper Use of Torque Wrenches & Drivers: Click Type
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by bicycle-tool maker Park Tool. The demonstration uses its products and the description links to its tools and repair resources. This is manufacturer education, not an independent tool comparison.
article_only_videos.summary: A March 2024 Park Tool demonstration of setting, using and storing its own click-type torque wrenches. It explains technique; torque values come from each component's instructions.

takeaways.text: Setting the wrench means reading the main scale and the fine dial together. On the two models shown, one dial turn adds a different amount, so check your own tool's scale before tightening.

Engage the bit fully and in line with the fastener, pull slowly with your hand centred on the handle, and stop as soon as the head deflects. At low settings the click can be faint, and turning further exceeds the set torque.
Park Tool says these wrenches are length-dependent: holding further back applies less torque than set, choking up applies more, and force should be applied at about 90° to the handle.

For storage, return the setting to the lowest value to unload the spring. Park Tool suggests calibration about yearly or every 5,000–10,000 clicks and warns that dropping the wrench can affect accuracy.

article_only_videos.title: Does Torque Equal Tension? | Tech Tuesday #235
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by bicycle-tool maker Park Tool. The description links to its repair resources and book, credits some footage to a bolting-technology company and links SRAM's recall notice. This is manufacturer education, not an independent test.
article_only_videos.summary: An April 2024 Park Tool explainer on why the same torque can produce different bolt tension when friction changes, with a spoke demonstration. General workshop education, not a torque specification.

takeaways.text: He uses a SRAM shifter-brake clamp bolt recall, linked in the description and involving excess thread-locking compound, as the starting example for why torque alone may not guarantee clamping tension.

Torque is the effort needed to turn the bolt; the useful clamping comes from tension, or preload. Corrosion, damaged threads, oil, grease, water or thread-locking compound change friction, so one torque value can give different tensions.

In his wheel demonstration, spokes brought to the same tension with four different thread preparations showed inconsistent nipple torque; even some spokes with the same preparation differed by more than 300%.
His conclusion: a torque wrench is useful but not a magic wand. Tighten to specification, then verify the joint where possible, for example with a force check.

article_only_videos.title: How Bicycle Headsets Work
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by bicycle-tool maker Park Tool. The demonstration uses its products and the description links to its tools and repair resources. This is manufacturer education, not an independent tool comparison.
article_only_videos.summary: An April 2025 Park Tool explainer of headset parts, internally routed designs, external-cup, zero-stack and integrated types, the SHIS headset code and stack height.

takeaways.text: Internally routed cockpits still use the ordinary threadless parts—top cap, stem, spacers, cover and compression ring—but the hoses pass through them, which Park Tool calls tedious to service.

Proprietary headsets exist and industry naming is inconsistent, so Park Tool starts with the bike maker's literature and then uses the SHIS code: fitting type, cup or bearing diameter and steerer diameter.
Stack height is recorded separately. A taller replacement can raise the stem unless spacers are removed, so Park Tool suggests choosing the same or a lower stack height.
In the closing example, the upper and lower bearings get separate codes—here ZS44/28.6 and ZS44/30—each with its own stack height.

article_only_videos.title: Integrated Headset Service - The Easy Way!
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by GCN Tech. The presenter describes a named Park Tool grease in promotional terms, and the description promotes the network's shop, insurance and Zwift club. Whether any product shown was supplied is not stated.
article_only_videos.summary: A September 2026 GCN Tech demonstration of checking and cleaning an integrated headset with internal hoses without disconnecting the brakes, and of when bearing replacement becomes the larger job.

takeaways.text: For a routine check he holds the front brake and rocks the bike, feeling and listening for movement at both bearings, then lifts the front and turns the bars to notice roughness.
Play means either too little preload or worn bearings. He sets preload with the top-cap bolt only as far as needed to remove play, then aligns the bars and tightens the stem bolts to specification.

On this bike the hoses run through the bearings, so he says replacing them means opening the hydraulic system, a bigger job possibly for a shop. His basic service avoids that by lifting the stem within the spare hose length.
Split spacers gave a little extra room, but he notes there was not much spare hose. He wipes surfaces with cleaner on a cloth rather than spraying it at the bearings.

article_only_videos.title: Everything You Need To Know About Power Meters
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by BikeRadar; the description promotes its magazine subscriptions. The presenter names a preferred product and mentions personally owned and previously reviewed units; how each unit shown was obtained is not fully stated.
article_only_videos.summary: An April 2026 BikeRadar explainer comparing crank-arm, spider and pedal power meters and single- versus dual-sided measurement, with the presenter's product preferences.

takeaways.text: A meter bonded to one crank arm ties the build to that crank length. His road unit needed a spacer to suit a gravel chainline, and its smallest chainring was a 34.
A spider meter lets you change crank length, but its chainring mounting limits ring sizes, and the example shown measures both legs without independent left-right balance.
Pedal meters move between bikes because pedal threads are shared, though body type, Q-factor and the cost of replacement bodies still differ by model.
His own dual-sided data put his left-right split at roughly 48/52 to 49/51, and the balance varied more at lower efforts. That is his reason to prefer dual-sided measurement when affordable.

article_only_videos.title: 96% of Cyclists Get Their Tyre Pressure Wrong. How To Get It Right
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by GCN Tech, which says it was given exclusive access to the test facility. The description links an earlier factory video from the premium tyre's maker and promotes the network's shop. The low-cost tyre was bought online; how the premium tyres were obtained is not stated.
article_only_videos.summary: A September 2024 GCN Tech test on a laboratory cycling-efficiency rig, comparing a premium and a low-cost 28 mm tyre across pressures on smooth and cobbled drum surfaces for one rider at one speed.

takeaways.text: The rig measures the efficiency of rider, bike and drum surface as one system while one variable changes and tyre temperature is monitored. It does not isolate a tyre's rolling resistance on its own.

He warns that too little pressure risks pinch flats and sidewall damage. The 28 mm tyres were not bottoming out at 2 bar, but the operators told him lower would reach the rim, which is why wider tyres permit lower pressure.

On smooth tarmac, both 28 mm tyres with the same TPU tubes were most efficient at 5 bar for this rider at 35 km/h, and the premium tyre stayed more efficient than the cheap one even at a poorer pressure.

On the roughest cobble surface, dropping the premium tyre from 4 to 2 bar cut the measured loss by about 20 W and felt far more comfortable; there, the cheap tyre at 2 bar also beat the premium tyre at 4 bar.

article_only_videos.title: Can You Get Faster With Shorter Cranks?
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by GCN Tech. The presenter thanks the fitting studio for its help, calls one saddle his favourite and discusses buying a particular bike; the description promotes the network's shop, insurance and club. Commercial terms for the session are not stated.
article_only_videos.summary: A May 2026 GCN Tech fitting-jig session in which one presenter tries 165 and 160 mm cranks against his 170 mm baseline and follows the knock-on changes to saddle and handlebar position.

takeaways.text: With only the crank shortened from 170 to 165 mm, motion capture showed his saddle was now too low; the correction is to raise it, not lower it.
Simply adding 5 mm of saddle height also moves the saddle back along the angled seatpost, which closes the hip angle. The jig compensated fore-aft, which in turn changed his reach to the bars.
Keeping the same front end then needed about 5 mm more bar height, which is harder with an integrated cockpit or an already-cut steerer.

With an already comfortable fit, he felt no clear gain at 165 or 160 mm. His conclusion: shorter cranks can help riders who need a more open hip angle, but not everyone needs them, and other changes can open the hip angle too.

article_only_videos.title: How to Size a Bicycle Chain
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by bicycle-tool maker Park Tool. The demonstration uses its products and the description links to its tools and repair resources. This is manufacturer education, not an independent tool comparison.
article_only_videos.summary: A February 2017 Park Tool walk-through of checking an old chain, matching a new chain to it, the largest-sprocket sizing method and the exceptions listed at the time.

takeaways.text: Before copying an old chain, he checks it: in the largest sprockets the shift must still work with a slight bend at each pulley, and in the smallest there should be no slack without the cage pulling the chain onto itself.
When matching a new chain to an old one, line up equivalent plate ends and compare rivet by rivet, remembering that a worn chain has lengthened.
Without a reliable old chain, the common method wraps the chain over the largest ring and largest cog without the derailleur, finds the nearest joinable rivet and adds two more.

The video lists exceptions: route chain guides first, compress rear suspension to its longest chain path, and, at its 2017 publication, SRAM 11- and 12-speed single-ring hardtail systems used four extra rivets instead of two.

article_only_videos.title: DON’T Buy A Used Bike Without Checking THIS
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by GCN Tech. The presenter recommends named Park Tool tools, and the description promotes the network's shop, insurance and club. Whether any product shown was supplied is not stated.
article_only_videos.summary: An August 2026 GCN Tech checklist for inspecting a used bike: wheels and tyres, bearings, drivetrain wear, shifting and hanger, frame and seatpost, brakes, headset and cockpit.

takeaways.text: He spins each wheel to listen for rough bearings, pulls it sideways to feel play, watches the rim for wobble and inspects rims and tyres for damage, cracks on carbon rims and deep cuts.
With the chain lifted off, the cranks should turn smoothly without play. Worn ring and cassette teeth look shark-finned, though shaped shift ramps are normal, and a chain checker shows chain wear.
He inspects high-stress areas such as the bottom bracket, dropouts, brake mounts, seat cluster, clamps and the top tube where a swinging bar can strike, and would walk away from a cracked frame.
He would use a needed brake bleed to negotiate on price rather than walk away, unlike a cracked frame.

article_only_videos.title: Is Your Saddle too far Forward OR Back? (HOW to Set Saddle Fore-Aft)
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by Cam Nicholls. The description links to a paid online bike-fit programme featuring the guest fitter and to the channel's free guide, and the video promotes a paid coaching course. This is the guest's fitting method, not a controlled study.
article_only_videos.summary: An October 2020 interview in which a physiotherapist bike fitter explains signs of a saddle set too far forward or back and a stepwise way to test fore-aft position.

takeaways.text: The fitter dismisses the knee-over-pedal plumb line as a rule because cleat position, limb lengths and knee shape vary between riders.
He compares a bike position to a spider's web: if bar reach or height is far off, set-back cannot be judged in isolation, because changing one contact point moves the others.
Too far forward, he says, tends to load the hands and quadriceps; too far back can strain the hamstrings and stretch the reach, though individual responses vary.
His trial: with the other contact points roughly right, start rearward and move forward in about 5 mm steps with sustained efforts, choosing the most forward position that does not add hand load.

article_only_videos.title: The Fastest Tyre Width is NOT What You Think
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by GCN Tech. The wind-tunnel session ran alongside testing by the wheel brand whose wheels were used, and the description promotes the network's shop, insurance and club. How the tyres and wheels were obtained is not stated.
article_only_videos.summary: A June 2025 GCN Tech test of one road tyre model in 28, 30, 35 and 40 mm for front-wheel aerodynamic drag and rolling losses on smooth surfaces at 30 and 40 km/h.

takeaways.text: He tested one tyre model in four widths with TPU tubes at calculator-recommended pressures, using a wider-rim wheel for the wider tyres; the wind-tunnel part measured a front wheel on its own.
Front-wheel aerodynamic differences were small: about 2.4 W from 28 to 40 mm at 30 km/h, and a 5.1 W penalty for the 40 mm tyre at 40 km/h.
On the efficiency rig the 30 mm tyre lost slightly less power than the 28 mm; the 35 and 40 mm lost more. For a pair, 30 instead of 40 mm saved about 19.5 W at 30 km/h and 24.3 W at 40 km/h.
He expects rougher surfaces to favour wider tyres at lower pressure but did not test that, and says pressure, surface, speed, grip and puncture protection can outweigh width.

article_only_videos.title: 1X vs 2X | What is the ULTIMATE Drivetrain For Your Bike?
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by CYCLINGABOUT. The description promotes the creator's own paid buyer's guides and Patreon, and the video relies partly on third-party test data rather than new measurements. No sponsor is named.
article_only_videos.summary: An August 2020 comparison of 1×, 2× and 3× drivetrains by gear steps, range, parts availability, chain life, cost, ease of use and frame design, drawing on the creator's data and third-party tests.

takeaways.text: He compares drivetrains by the cadence drop each shift causes. At his preferred 80–90 rpm, a 1×12 upshift in his example cost about 13 rpm, against about 11 rpm for his 2×11 and 3×10 examples.
With the lowest gear pegged at the same speed, his 1× examples topped out around 47–48 km/h, while the 2× and 3× examples gave roughly 15–20% more top speed.
For beginners he rates 1× the easiest to use and maintain; with two or three rings the rider must also avoid cross-chaining.
Front derailleurs and the inner-ring chainline can interfere with the rear tyre and limit chainstay length, which he gives as a main reason for 1× on mountain bikes.

article_only_videos.title: What Type of Bottom Bracket do I Have?
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by bicycle-tool maker Park Tool. The demonstration uses its products and the description links to its tools and repair resources. This is manufacturer education, not an independent tool comparison.
article_only_videos.summary: A September 2019 Park Tool walk-through for identifying the bottom-bracket type on a bike in hand: press-fit, thread-together and threaded-shell systems.

takeaways.text: With the crank removed, the tool fittings narrow the type: a cup with no external or internal fittings is a press-fit bottom bracket in an unthreaded shell.
Thread-together bottom brackets sit in an unthreaded shell but look much like cups in a threaded shell; Park Tool warns that guessing wrong can damage the frame or components.
Clues include a printed standard such as T47 on the cup or threads visible on only one side inside the shell; if it remains unclear, a cup may need to come out so the shell can be inspected.
The video ends by noting that new standards and tool fittings keep appearing, so the bike maker or a shop may be needed.

article_only_videos.title: How to Align a Hydraulic Disc Brake on a Bike
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by bicycle-tool maker Park Tool. The demonstration uses its products and the description links to its tools and repair resources. This is manufacturer education, not an independent tool comparison.
article_only_videos.summary: A May 2018 Park Tool demonstration of diagnosing hydraulic disc-brake rub and aligning the caliper.

takeaways.text: Diagnosis comes first: with the bike raised and the caliper back-lit, spin the wheel and sight the pad gaps; slight rub with barely any noise may not need adjustment.
Before moving the caliper, check full wheel seating, a bent or loose rotor, hub bearing play and sticking pistons; each can cause or amplify rub.
The basic alignment loosens the caliper bolts, squeezes the lever to centre the caliper, snugs the bolts while holding it and rechecks; finer adjustment moves one bolt at a time.
Add no washers the design did not include. If alignment still fails, Park Tool points to the caliper mounts, which a shop must assess.

article_only_videos.title: How to Convert Your Bicycle Tires to Tubeless
article_only_videos.disclosure: Published by bicycle-tool maker Park Tool. The demonstration uses its products and the description links to its tools and repair resources. This is manufacturer education, not an independent tool comparison.
article_only_videos.summary: An August 2016 Park Tool demonstration of converting a wheel to tubeless (rim preparation, tape, valve and troubleshooting) with its stated compatibility limits.

takeaways.text: Park Tool says conversion is possible but limited: ideally both rim and tyre are designated tubeless-ready, yet there is no true industry-wide fit standard, so results vary.
After removing the old rim strip and cleaning the rim channel, choose tape of the right width: too narrow will not seal, and too wide can interfere with the bead seat.
Punch a round valve hole through the tape; in the video, a knife-cut slit is shown as a hole the valve may not cover.
A conversion may take hours or even days to seal, and a non-tubeless tyre in the example seeped air through its sidewalls.

context.en: See an SR+ become a complete bike in this workshop build. Its custom parts illustrate the choices a frame purchase leaves open; it is not an SR comparison or a controlled test of the claimed 65 g frame difference.
context.zh-Hans: 这段工作室装车视频展示 SR+ 如何变成整车。定制配件说明买车架后仍需作出的选择；它并非 SR 对比测试，也不能验证厂家宣称的 65 克车架差异。
context.de: Dieser Werkstattaufbau zeigt, wie aus einem SR+ ein komplettes Rad wird. Die frei gewählten Teile verdeutlichen die Entscheidungen nach dem Rahmenkauf. Das Video ist kein Vergleich mit dem SR und kein kontrollierter Test der angegebenen 65 g Rahmendifferenz.

context.en: The SR+ workshop build gives a closer look at the Speedster platform and component choices. The fitted tires in a custom build do not establish the approved 1× or 2× limits; use the manufacturer's drivetrain-specific records above.
context.zh-Hans: SR+ 的工作室装车视频可帮助观察 Speedster 平台及配件选择。定制整车所装的轮胎不能证明获准的 1× 或 2× 上限；仍须查看上方按传动布局区分的厂家记录。
context.de: Der SR+ Werkstattaufbau zeigt die Speedster-Plattform und die Komponentenwahl näher. Montierte Reifen eines individuellen Aufbaus belegen keine freigegebenen 1× oder 2× Grenzen. Maßgeblich bleiben die oben verlinkten Herstellerangaben zum jeweiligen Antrieb.

context.en: NERO discusses using 40 mm tires on the road and the geometry trade-offs of the Tavelo Grow. This is useful wider-tire context, but the Grow is a different frame from the Arden compared here; the review cannot establish Arden clearance or fit.
context.zh-Hans: NERO 讨论在公路上使用 40 毫米轮胎，以及 Tavelo Grow 的几何取舍。它为宽胎使用提供背景，但 Grow 与本文比较的 Arden 是不同车架；该评测不能证明 Arden 的轮胎空间或适配性。
context.de: NERO bespricht 40 mm Reifen auf der Straße und die Geometrie des Tavelo Grow. Das ergänzt die Einordnung breiter Reifen. Der Grow ist jedoch ein anderer Rahmen als der hier verglichene Arden; das Video belegt weder dessen Reifenfreiheit noch dessen Passform.

context.en: Tom Bowers walks through the parts in his LightCarbon LCG071-PRO gravel build. Use it to spot the wheels, shifting, cranks and finishing parts a frame price leaves out. His UK budget and LCG071-PRO frame are separate from the LCG071S-PRO and Voyager examples here.
context.zh-Hans: Tom Bowers 介绍其 LightCarbon LCG071-PRO 砂石车的配件，可用来检查车架报价之外还需的轮组、变速、曲柄和其他零件。他的英国预算及 LCG071-PRO 车架，与本文 LCG071S-PRO 和 Voyager 示例不同。
context.de: Tom Bowers stellt die Teile seines LightCarbon LCG071-PRO Gravelaufbaus vor. Das hilft, Laufräder, Schaltung, Kurbel und weitere Teile außerhalb des Rahmenpreises zu erfassen. Sein britisches Budget und der LCG071-PRO sind von den LCG071S-PRO und Voyager Beispielen hier zu unterscheiden.

context.en: Follow an ICAN Graro workshop assembly to see the work behind a frame-only purchase. The Wheeltop GeX and other parts belong to this custom build; use it for assembly context, not as installation instructions or proof that the article's component combinations fit.
context.zh-Hans: 跟随 ICAN Graro 的工作室装车过程，了解只买车架之后还需要完成的工作。Wheeltop GeX 及其他配件属于该定制整车；视频用于理解装车过程，不能替代安装说明，也不能证明本文配件组合一定兼容。
context.de: Der ICAN Graro Werkstattaufbau zeigt den Arbeitsaufwand nach einem reinen Rahmenkauf. Wheeltop GeX und weitere Teile gehören zu diesem individuellen Aufbau. Das Video dient als Anschauung, ersetzt keine Montageanleitung und belegt nicht die Kompatibilität der im Artikel genannten Kombinationen.

context.en: See the V3's shape in this 2025 US seller video. The frame revision and parts may differ from the T47 builds compared above; it does not verify their clearance, weight or mainland China prices, and it does not show the PARDUS build.
context.zh-Hans: 这段 2025 年美国商家视频展示 V3 外观。车架版本和配件可能与上方比较的 T47 整车不同；它不能证明这些整车的轮胎空间、重量或中国大陆价格，也没有展示 PARDUS 配置。
context.de: Dieses US-Händlervideo von 2025 zeigt die Form des V3. Rahmenversion und Teile können von den oben verglichenen T47 Aufbauten abweichen. Es belegt weder deren Reifenfreiheit, Gewicht oder Preise in Festlandchina und zeigt auch nicht den PARDUS-Aufbau.

context.en: The Watt Life itemizes a Winspace T1550 Gen 2 custom build and compares it with a complete-bike offer. It is a useful example of comparing the whole parts list, not just the frame. The creator's historical costs are not current landed quotes for your destination or the three models above.
context.zh-Hans: The Watt Life 逐项计算 Winspace T1550 Gen 2 定制整车成本，并与整车报价比较，可帮助理解为什么要比较完整配件清单而非只看车架。创作者的历史费用并非您目的地或上方三款车型的当前落地报价。
context.de: The Watt Life schlüsselt einen Winspace T1550 Gen 2 Aufbau auf und vergleicht ihn mit einem Komplettradangebot. Das zeigt, warum die gesamte Teileliste zählt. Die historischen Kosten des Erstellers sind keine aktuellen Gesamtkosten für Ihren Zielort oder die drei Modelle oben.

context.en: A UK workshop's Graro ride review gives a concrete ownership example for one of the direct-order brands discussed here. Its custom parts and ride impressions are specific to that bike; they do not establish EU warehouse stock, import charges or another buyer's warranty experience.
context.zh-Hans: 英国工作室的 Graro 骑行评测，为本文讨论的一家直购品牌提供具体使用案例。定制配件和骑行感受只对应那辆车，不能证明欧盟仓库存、进口费用或其他买家的保修体验。
context.de: Der Graro Fahrbericht einer britischen Werkstatt ergänzt die hier besprochenen Direktkaufmarken um ein konkretes Beispiel. Teile und Fahreindrücke gelten für dieses Rad. Sie belegen weder EU-Lagerbestand, Einfuhrkosten noch die Garantieerfahrung anderer Käufer.

context.en: This Winspace T1550 Gen 2 cost breakdown makes the frame-versus-finished-bike distinction tangible before you compare a direct order with a dealer build. Keep the creator's component choices and dated costs separate from your own shipping, tax, assembly and support quotes.
context.zh-Hans: 这份 Winspace T1550 Gen 2 成本拆解，可在比较直购与经销商装车之前，直观说明车架价与可骑整车成本的区别。创作者的配件选择及历史费用，应与您的运费、税费、装配和售后报价分开。
context.de: Die Kostenaufstellung des Winspace T1550 Gen 2 verdeutlicht den Unterschied zwischen Rahmenpreis und fahrfertigem Rad vor dem Vergleich mit einem Händleraufbau. Trennen Sie die Teilewahl und damaligen Kosten des Erstellers von Ihren eigenen Angeboten für Versand, Steuern, Montage und Betreuung.

context.en: Cyclingnews shows and rides a SEKA Spear RDC, one of the models linked in this guide. It helps you identify the bike you are discussing with a dealer. The test build and ride impressions do not prove local stock, regional support or the experience of the owners quoted above.
context.zh-Hans: Cyclingnews 展示并骑行本文链接的 SEKA Spear RDC，可帮助您在与经销商沟通时确认车型。测试配置和骑行感受不能证明当地库存、地区售后服务或上方所引车主的经历。
context.de: Cyclingnews zeigt und fährt den in diesem Leitfaden verlinkten SEKA Spear RDC. Das erleichtert die Zuordnung beim Gespräch mit einem Händler. Testaufbau und Fahreindrücke belegen weder lokalen Lagerbestand, regionale Betreuung noch die oben zitierten Erfahrungen anderer Besitzer.

context.en: The Graro workshop build illustrates the components and assembly a frame-only order still needs. It is a UK custom build, not a US or Canadian landed-cost quote; the video does not establish that this frame ships from ICAN's US warehouse.
context.zh-Hans: Graro 的工作室装车视频展示只订车架之后仍需的配件与装配。它是英国定制整车，并非美国或加拿大的落地报价，也不能证明这款车架从 ICAN 美国仓发货。
context.de: Der Graro Werkstattaufbau zeigt, welche Teile und Montagearbeiten nach einer Rahmenbestellung noch fehlen. Es ist ein britischer Aufbau, kein Gesamtkostenangebot für die USA oder Kanada. Das Video belegt auch nicht, dass dieser Rahmen aus ICANs US-Lager versandt wird.

context.en: See how a G21 frame becomes one customer's complete bike. The separate cockpit, wheels and drivetrain show why a frame price is only one part of a quote. This August 2026 workshop build is not a current delivered offer or a test of every G21 configuration.
context.zh-Hans: 这段视频展示 G21 车架如何按一位客户的要求装成整车。独立把组、轮组和传动说明，车架价格只是报价的一部分。这是2026年8月的工作室装车记录，并非当前落地报价，也不代表所有 G21 配置。
context.de: Hier wird aus einem G21-Rahmen das Rad eines Kunden. Separates Cockpit, Laufräder und Antrieb zeigen, warum der Rahmenpreis nur einen Teil des Angebots ausmacht. Der Werkstattaufbau vom August 2026 ist weder ein aktuelles Lieferangebot noch ein Test aller G21-Konfigurationen.

context.en: A 2025 Falath EXP build shows a retailer choosing mechanical 105 as part of a complete custom specification. Use it to identify what the quote includes, not as a controlled electronic-versus-mechanical test or a current price comparison.
context.zh-Hans: 这段2025年的 Falath EXP 装车视频展示商家如何把机械105纳入一套定制配置。它有助于看清报价包含哪些零件，但不是电变与机械变速的控制变量测试，也不是当前价格对比。
context.de: Dieser Falath-EXP-Aufbau von 2025 zeigt mechanische 105 als Teil einer vollständigen Kundenkonfiguration. Prüfe daran den Lieferumfang. Das Video ist kein kontrollierter Vergleich mit elektronischer Schaltung und kein aktueller Preisvergleich.

context.en: This June 2025 Falath EXP build makes the order checklist concrete: agree the cockpit, saddle and other parts before assembly. It shows one customer's bike, not a 2026 revision, a standard package, or evidence for the shop's broad performance claims.
context.zh-Hans: 这段2025年6月的 Falath EXP 装车记录把订单清单变得具体：装车前确认把组、坐垫及其他配件。它展示的是一位客户的整车，并非2026年新版本或标准套装，也不能证明商家的泛化性能宣传。
context.de: Der Falath-EXP-Aufbau vom Juni 2025 macht die Bestellliste anschaulich: Cockpit, Sattel und weitere Teile vor der Montage festlegen. Gezeigt wird ein Kundenrad, keine 2026er Revision oder Serienausstattung und kein Beleg für pauschale Leistungsversprechen.

context.en: Compare this mechanic's everyday-tool list with the jobs you will actually repeat. Treat the waxing station as his preference, not an automatic fifth purchase; exact tool compatibility and the maker's instructions still govern each job.
context.zh-Hans: 把这位技师的常用工具清单与您真正会反复做的工作比较。上蜡设备是他的偏好，不是必买的第五件工具；每项工作仍须核对工具适配性，并遵循具体零件的厂家说明。
context.de: Vergleiche die Werkzeugauswahl mit den Arbeiten, die du tatsächlich wiederholst. Die Wachsstation ist seine Präferenz, kein automatischer fünfter Kauf. Passendes Werkzeug und die Anleitung des jeweiligen Komponentenherstellers bleiben entscheidend.

context.en: This rider's follow-up is useful for its limits: he likes the routine but says his records do not prove slower wear. Keep your own chain measurements and the exact maker's replacement threshold; the video's general threshold is not an instruction for every chain.
context.zh-Hans: 这段后续体验的价值也在于它说明了局限：骑手喜欢这套流程，但承认记录不足以证明磨损更慢。仍需测量自己的链条，并按具体厂家阈值更换；视频中的笼统阈值不能套用所有链条。
context.de: Der Erfahrungsbericht benennt seine Grenzen: Der Fahrer mag den Ablauf, kann langsameren Verschleiß mit seinen Aufzeichnungen aber nicht belegen. Miss die eigene Kette und beachte die Austauschgrenze ihres Herstellers. Die allgemeine Grenze im Video gilt nicht für jede Kette.

context.en: If your exact wheel and tyre permit a backup tube, this older demonstration gives you inspection questions to practise with the assembler. It is a conventional tube repair, not a tubeless-plug tutorial. Use current wheel, tyre and tube instructions; do not copy its unsupported-tube inflation demonstration onto a TPU tube or treat it as hookless approval.
context.zh-Hans: 只有具体轮圈与外胎允许使用备用内胎时，才把这段较早的演示作为向装配技师练习提问的参考。它讲的是常规内胎修理，不是真空胎补胎胶条教学。操作仍以当前轮圈、外胎和内胎说明为准；不要把视频中内胎离开外胎后的充气演示照搬到TPU内胎，也不能把它当作无钩轮圈适配许可。
context.de: Erlauben dein genaues Laufrad und dein Reifen einen Ersatzschlauch, liefert die ältere Vorführung Fragen für die Übung mit der Werkstatt. Sie behandelt eine normale Schlauchreparatur, keine Tubeless-Stopfen. Maßgeblich sind aktuelle Laufrad-, Reifen- und Schlauchanleitungen. Übertrage das Aufpumpen außerhalb des Reifens nicht auf TPU und verstehe das Video nicht als Hookless-Freigabe.

context.en: Use the surface examples to describe your own route, not to copy a universal tyre width or pressure. This 2022 discussion is not a current tyre test. Tubeless can still suffer tyre or rim damage, and the advanced trail footage does not establish that your bike, equipment or skills suit the same terrain.
context.zh-Hans: 可以借视频中的路面例子描述自己的路线，但不要照搬统一胎宽或胎压。这是2022年的讨论，不是当前轮胎测试。真空胎仍可能发生轮胎或轮圈损伤；高难度林道画面也不能证明您的车辆、装备或技术适合相同地形。
context.de: Beschreibe mit den Oberflächenbeispielen deine eigene Strecke, statt eine allgemeine Reifenbreite oder einen Druck zu übernehmen. Die Diskussion von 2022 ist kein aktueller Reifentest. Auch Tubeless schützt nicht vor Reifen- oder Felgenschäden. Die anspruchsvollen Fahrszenen belegen keine Eignung deines Rads, deiner Ausrüstung oder deiner Fähigkeiten.

context.en: This 2022 Scott example helps separate the wheel-and-tyre swap from the frame and drivetrain you will keep. The creator's road-speed comparison is personal riding context, not controlled proof that every gravel bike matches a road bike. Check your actual fit, gearing and approved wheel/tyre packages before buying the second set.
context.zh-Hans: 这段2022年的Scott装车例子，可以帮助区分会更换的轮组、轮胎与仍保留的车架、传动。创作者的公路速度对比属于个人骑行体验，不能作为所有砂石车都与公路车同速的对照证据。购买第二套轮组前，先核对自己的骑姿、齿比及获准的轮胎、轮圈组合。
context.de: Das Scott-Beispiel von 2022 trennt den Wechsel von Laufrädern und Reifen vom beibehaltenen Rahmen und Antrieb. Der Geschwindigkeitsvergleich ist persönliche Fahrerfahrung, kein kontrollierter Nachweis gleicher Geschwindigkeit für jedes Gravelrad. Prüfe vor dem zweiten Laufradsatz deine Position, Übersetzung und freigegebenen Rad-Reifen-Kombinationen.

context.en: Watch how the presenter states the protocol, then identifies its limits and separates ride impressions from timed runs. This 2022 comparison is an evidence-reading example, not a current wheel ranking. Its historical prices, quality comments and crosswind experience do not establish today's offers or the behaviour of every model in either brand's range.
context.zh-Hans: 留意创作者怎样说明测试流程，随后指出局限，并把骑感与计时数据分开。这段2022年的对比适合练习阅读证据，不是当前轮组排名。视频中的历史价格、质量评价及侧风体验，不能证明今天的报价，也不能代表任一品牌全系列车型的表现。
context.de: Achte darauf, wie der Fahrer das Protokoll erklärt, dessen Grenzen benennt und Fahreindrücke von Fahrzeiten trennt. Der Vergleich von 2022 dient zum Einordnen von Belegen, nicht als aktuelle Laufradrangliste. Historische Preise, Qualitätsurteile und Seitenwinderfahrungen belegen weder heutige Angebote noch das Verhalten jeder aktuellen Baureihe.

context.en: This 2026 home-workshop test shows why one sample is weak evidence in either direction. The presenter says his static rig is not the ISO procedure or an impact test, and he could not check consistency or damaged parts. Use it as a reminder to ask for test evidence that names your exact part, not as a pass or fail for any brand.
context.zh-Hans: 这段2026年的家庭工作室测试说明，单个样品无论“通过”还是“断裂”，都只是很薄弱的证据。作者明确表示，他的静载装置不是ISO测试流程，也不是冲击测试；他也无法检验批次一致性或受损零件的表现。请把它当作提醒：索取能对应你具体零件的测试证据，而不是把视频结果当成任何品牌的合格或不合格结论。
context.de: Dieser Werkstatttest von 2026 zeigt, warum ein einzelnes Exemplar in beide Richtungen ein schwacher Beleg ist. Der Autor sagt selbst, dass sein statischer Aufbau weder das ISO-Verfahren noch ein Aufpralltest ist; Serienstreuung und beschädigte Teile konnte er nicht prüfen. Nimm ihn als Anlass, Prüfnachweise für dein konkretes Teil zu verlangen – nicht als Bestanden oder Durchgefallen für eine Marke.

context.en: This 2023 mountain-bike explainer makes the three terms visible: a bendable conventional hanger, the UDH frame interface and SRAM's hangerless direct-mount derailleur. It does not cover road or gravel XPLR approval, and the presenter's remark that UDH rear ends are identical is not fit approval for any particular frame. Confirm a Full Mount build with the frame maker.
context.zh-Hans: 这段2023年的山地车讲解，把三个概念直观地区分开：会弯的传统尾钩、UDH车架接口，以及SRAM取消尾钩的直装式后拨。视频没有涉及公路或砂石XPLR套件的适配许可；作者所说“UDH车架后端都一样”，也不等于某个具体车架已获适配许可。若计划使用Full Mount，请向车架厂商确认完整方案。
context.de: Dieses Mountainbike-Erklärvideo von 2023 macht die drei Begriffe sichtbar: das biegsame herkömmliche Schaltauge, die UDH-Rahmenschnittstelle und SRAMs Direktmontage-Schaltwerk ohne Schaltauge. Freigaben für Rennrad- oder Gravel-XPLR behandelt es nicht, und die Aussage, alle UDH-Hinterbauten seien gleich, ersetzt keine Freigabe für einen bestimmten Rahmen. Kläre einen Full-Mount-Aufbau mit dem Rahmenhersteller.

context.en: Park Tool demonstrates its own click-type wrenches: setting the scale, where to hold the handle, when to stop and how to store the tool. It shows technique for those models, not torque values for your parts or proof that another wrench works the same way. Read the exact tool's and component's instructions before tightening.
context.zh-Hans: Park Tool在视频中演示自家的咔嗒式扭力扳手：如何设定刻度、手握在哪里、何时停止施力，以及如何存放。它展示的是这些型号的操作方法，不提供你零件的扭矩数值，也不能证明其他扳手用法相同。拧紧前，请阅读你所用工具和零件的说明书。
context.de: Park Tool zeigt den Umgang mit den eigenen Klick-Drehmomentschlüsseln: Skala einstellen, Griff richtig halten, rechtzeitig aufhören und das Werkzeug lagern. Das ist Technik für diese Modelle – keine Anzugsmomente für deine Teile und kein Beleg, dass ein anderer Schlüssel genauso funktioniert. Lies vor dem Anziehen die Anleitungen deines Werkzeugs und der Bauteile.

context.en: Park Tool's explainer shows why this section treats the surface and the thread as separate decisions: lubricant, corrosion or thread-locking compound changes how much clamping tension a torque value produces. It is general workshop education, not a torque value or product approval for your carbon parts; follow each manufacturer's specified preparation for every interface.
context.zh-Hans: Park Tool的讲解说明了本节为何要把接触面和螺纹分开处理：润滑剂、锈蚀或螺纹胶都会改变同一扭矩值产生的夹紧张力。视频属于通用维修知识，不提供扭矩数值，也不代表认可你的碳纤维零件或某款产品；每个接口都应按相应厂商规定的处理方式操作。
context.de: Das Park-Tool-Video zeigt, warum dieser Abschnitt Kontaktfläche und Gewinde getrennt behandelt: Schmiermittel, Korrosion oder Schraubensicherung verändern, wie viel Klemmkraft ein Anzugsmoment tatsächlich erzeugt. Es ist allgemeines Werkstattwissen, kein Drehmomentwert und keine Freigabe für deine Carbonteile; halte dich an jeder Schnittstelle an die vom Hersteller vorgeschriebene Vorbereitung.

context.en: Park Tool's explainer adds the headset code to this checklist: fitting type, cup or bearing diameter, steerer diameter and stack height, recorded separately for the upper and lower positions. It does not cover bearing contact angles for your frame, and its example sizes are not the LCR018-D's; the exact frame drawing still decides the replacement.
context.zh-Hans: Park Tool的讲解为这份清单补充了碗组代码：安装方式、碗或轴承直径、竖管直径和堆叠高度，并且上下两个位置分别记录。视频没有涉及你车架所需的轴承接触角度，示例尺寸也不是LCR018-D的数据；替换件仍应以该车架的准确图纸为准。
context.de: Das Park-Tool-Video ergänzt diese Checkliste um den Steuersatz-Code: Einbauart, Schalen- oder Lagerdurchmesser, Gabelschaftdurchmesser und Einbauhöhe, getrennt für oberes und unteres Lager notiert. Lagerkontaktwinkel für deinen Rahmen behandelt es nicht, und die Beispielmaße sind nicht die des LCR018-D; über das Ersatzteil entscheidet weiterhin die genaue Rahmenzeichnung.

context.en: GCN Tech shows the distinction a quote should capture: on this integrated bike, checking, cleaning and regreasing the headset fits within the spare hose length, while the presenter says replacing the bearings means opening the hydraulic system. Your frame, cockpit and brakes may differ, so ask the workshop which of those jobs your exact design requires.
context.zh-Hans: GCN Tech的演示正好说明报价时应区分的情况：在这辆一体化车上，检查、清洁和重新上脂可以在多余油管长度允许的范围内完成；而作者表示，更换轴承就需要打开液压系统。你的车架、车把和刹车可能不同，请让车行说明你的具体设计需要哪些工作。
context.de: GCN Tech zeigt den Unterschied, den ein Kostenvoranschlag festhalten sollte: An diesem integrierten Rad lassen sich Prüfen, Reinigen und Nachfetten des Steuersatzes mit der vorhandenen Leitungsreserve erledigen, während laut Autor ein Lagertausch das Öffnen der Hydraulik bedeutet. Rahmen, Cockpit und Bremsen können sich unterscheiden – frag die Werkstatt, welche dieser Arbeiten dein Aufbau erfordert.

context.en: BikeRadar's explainer walks through the trade-offs this section asks you to plan: a crank-arm meter fixed to one crank length, a spider limited by chainring mounting, and pedals that move between bikes. Product preferences and prices in the video are the presenter's 2026 views, not China Bikes recommendations or current offers.
context.zh-Hans: BikeRadar的讲解梳理了本节要求你提前规划的取舍：曲柄式功率计固定在一种曲柄长度上，星盘式受牙盘安装规格限制，踏板式则可以在不同车之间换装。视频中的产品偏好和价格是作者2026年的个人观点，不是China Bikes的推荐，也不代表当前报价。
context.de: Das BikeRadar-Video erklärt die Abwägungen, die dieser Abschnitt einplanen lässt: Ein Kurbelarm-Messgerät ist an eine Kurbellänge gebunden, ein Spider an die Kettenblattaufnahme, Pedale lassen sich zwischen Rädern wechseln. Produktvorlieben und Preise im Video sind Ansichten des Autors von 2026, keine Empfehlungen von China Bikes und keine aktuellen Angebote.

context.en: GCN Tech's 2024 rig test shows why this guide starts with surface, tyre and pressure. For one rider at 35 km/h, the premium tyre stayed faster on smooth tarmac even when poorly inflated, while on rough cobbles the right pressure mattered more than the tyre's price. The test used inner tubes and compared no wheels; it is not a target pressure or a wattage promise for your bike.
context.zh-Hans: GCN Tech这项2024年的台架测试说明，为什么本指南先从路面、轮胎和胎压入手。对这位时速35公里的骑手来说，在平整沥青路上，高端轮胎即使胎压不理想也更快；而在粗糙的石块路面上，合适的胎压比轮胎价格更重要。测试使用内胎，也没有比较轮组，因此它不是你车的目标胎压，也不能换算成功率承诺。
context.de: Der Prüfstandtest von GCN Tech aus dem Jahr 2024 zeigt, warum dieser Ratgeber mit Belag, Reifen und Luftdruck beginnt. Für einen Fahrer bei 35 km/h blieb der Premiumreifen auf glattem Asphalt selbst mit ungünstigem Druck schneller, auf grobem Kopfsteinpflaster zählte der passende Druck mehr als der Reifenpreis. Getestet wurde mit Schläuchen und ohne Laufradvergleich – kein Zieldruck und kein Wattversprechen für dein Rad.

context.en: In this 2026 fitting-jig session, GCN Tech shows how a 5 mm shorter crank moved the presenter's saddle height, set-back and bar position together, and he felt no clear gain with an already comfortable fit. It records one rider on a jig, not an outdoor ride or a performance result, so plan your own trial with a fitter.
context.zh-Hans: 在这段2026年的Fitting台架测试中，GCN Tech展示了曲柄缩短5毫米后，主持人的座高、座垫前后位置和车把位置如何一起改变；而在原本就舒适的姿势下，他并未感到明显改善。这只是一位骑手在台架上的记录，不是户外骑行或成绩测试，请与Fitting师一起规划你自己的试验。
context.de: In dieser Sitzung von 2026 am Bikefitting-Gerät zeigt GCN Tech, wie eine 5 mm kürzere Kurbel Sattelhöhe, Sattelversatz und Lenkerposition des Moderators gemeinsam verschob; mit seiner bereits bequemen Position spürte er keinen klaren Vorteil. Das ist die Aufzeichnung eines Fahrers am Gerät, keine Ausfahrt und kein Leistungsnachweis – plane deinen eigenen Versuch mit einem Bikefitter.

context.en: Park Tool's 2017 walk-through shows why this guide refuses a universal rule: the old-chain check, the largest-sprocket method and its listed exceptions already differ by system. Newer 1×, full-mount and wireless drivetrains can have their own sizing instructions, so the exact component manual still decides your chain length.
context.zh-Hans: Park Tool这段2017年的教学正好说明，本指南为何不给出通用规则：旧链条的检查方法、大盘大飞计算法以及视频列出的例外情况，本来就因系统而异。较新的单盘、Full Mount和无线传动可能有各自的截链说明，你的链条长度仍应以具体零件说明书为准。
context.de: Die Park-Tool-Anleitung von 2017 zeigt, warum dieser Ratgeber keine Universalregel nennt: Die Prüfung der alten Kette, die Methode über das größte Ritzel und die aufgeführten Ausnahmen unterscheiden sich schon je nach System. Neuere 1×-, Full-Mount- und Funkantriebe können eigene Vorgaben haben; über die Kettenlänge entscheidet weiterhin die Anleitung der jeweiligen Komponente.

context.en: GCN Tech's 2026 checklist shows what a careful hands-on look can find before money changes hands: bearing play, worn drivetrain parts, brake feel and visible frame or clamp damage. The presenter treats a crack as a reason to walk away. A clean result still cannot rule out hidden carbon damage, so keep the qualified assessment this section recommends.
context.zh-Hans: GCN Tech这份2026年的检查清单展示了付款前仔细动手检查能发现的问题：轴承旷量、传动件磨损、刹车手感，以及车架或夹持部位的可见损伤。主持人认为一旦发现裂纹就应放弃购买。但即使检查结果良好，也无法排除碳纤维的隐藏损伤，本节建议的专业评估仍然必要。
context.de: Die Checkliste von GCN Tech aus dem Jahr 2026 zeigt, was eine sorgfältige Prüfung vor dem Bezahlen finden kann: Lagerspiel, verschlissene Antriebsteile, Bremsgefühl und sichtbare Schäden an Rahmen oder Klemmstellen. Bei einem Riss rät der Moderator vom Kauf ab. Ein unauffälliges Ergebnis schließt verborgene Carbonschäden aber nicht aus – die in diesem Abschnitt empfohlene fachkundige Beurteilung bleibt nötig.

context.en: In this 2020 interview, a physiotherapist bike fitter explains why set-back cannot be read from a frame chart: it interacts with bar reach and height, cleats and saddle height. His trial moves the saddle in small steps while watching hand load and muscle fatigue. Treat it as one fitter's method, and keep every change within the saddle-rail markings and seatpost limits.
context.zh-Hans: 在这段2020年的访谈中，一位兼任物理治疗师的Fitting师解释了为什么座垫后移量无法从车架几何表直接读出：它与车把距离和高度、锁片及座高相互影响。他的试验方法是小步移动座垫，同时观察手部负荷和肌肉疲劳。请把它视为一位Fitting师的方法，所有调整都应保持在座弓刻度和座杆限制范围内。
context.de: In diesem Interview von 2020 erklärt ein Bikefitter und Physiotherapeut, warum sich der Sattelversatz nicht aus der Geometrietabelle ablesen lässt: Er hängt mit Lenkerreichweite und -höhe, Cleats und Sattelhöhe zusammen. Bei seinem Versuch wird der Sattel in kleinen Schritten verschoben, während Handbelastung und Muskelermüdung beobachtet werden. Das ist die Methode eines Fitters; bleib bei jeder Änderung innerhalb der Markierungen am Sattelgestell und der Grenzen der Sattelstütze.

context.en: GCN Tech's 2025 test helps separate width from tread: with one road tyre model on smooth surfaces, the 30 mm size lost slightly less power than the 28, while 35 and 40 mm cost noticeably more. It used inner tubes, particular wheels and calculator pressures and did not test rough roads, so use it to choose width deliberately, not as a prediction for your tyres.
context.zh-Hans: GCN Tech这项2025年的测试有助于把胎宽和花纹分开考虑：同一款公路胎在平整路面上，30毫米版本的功率损耗略低于28毫米，而35和40毫米明显更高。测试使用内胎、特定轮组和计算器推荐胎压，也没有测试粗糙路面，因此它只能帮助你有意识地选择胎宽，不能预测你的轮胎表现。
context.de: Der Test von GCN Tech aus dem Jahr 2025 hilft, Breite und Profil zu trennen: Mit einem Straßenreifenmodell auf glattem Belag verlor die 30-mm-Version etwas weniger Leistung als die 28-mm-Version, 35 und 40 mm kosteten deutlich mehr. Getestet wurde mit Schläuchen, bestimmten Laufrädern und Rechner-Drücken, ohne raue Straßen – wähle die Breite bewusst, aber nimm das nicht als Vorhersage für deine Reifen.

context.en: CYCLINGABOUT's 2020 comparison looks at the middle-gear question through cadence: how many rpm each shift costs at the rider's preferred pedalling speed, alongside range and frame constraints. Its parts, prices and cited third-party test figures date from 2020; apply the method to your own proposed cassette rather than adopting its scorecard.
context.zh-Hans: CYCLINGABOUT这段2020年的对比从踏频角度看中间档位：在骑手习惯的踏频下每次换档会损失多少转速，同时比较齿比范围和车架限制。视频中的零件、价格及引用的第三方测试数据均来自2020年；请把这种方法用在你自己计划的飞轮上，而不是照搬它的评分。
context.de: Der Vergleich von CYCLINGABOUT aus dem Jahr 2020 betrachtet die mittleren Gänge über die Trittfrequenz: Wie viele Umdrehungen kostet jeder Schaltvorgang bei der bevorzugten Kadenz – dazu Bandbreite und Rahmengrenzen. Teile, Preise und zitierte Fremdtests stammen von 2020; wende die Methode auf deine geplante Kassette an, statt die Punktewertung zu übernehmen.

context.en: Park Tool's walk-through shows how tool fittings, markings and the shell interior separate press-fit, thread-together and threaded systems on a bike you already have. Before ordering, the exact frame drawing and the sheet below still decide the part, and cups should not be removed by guesswork: Park Tool itself warns that a wrong guess can damage the frame.
context.zh-Hans: Park Tool的教学展示了如何在已到手的车上，通过工具接口、标记和五通内部来区分压入式、对锁式和螺纹式中轴。下单前，仍应以车架的准确图纸和下方表格确定零件；也不要凭猜测拆卸碗组——Park Tool自己也提醒，判断错误可能损坏车架。
context.de: Die Park-Tool-Anleitung zeigt, wie Werkzeugaufnahmen, Markierungen und das Innere des Tretlagergehäuses Press-Fit-, Thread-Together- und Gewindesysteme an einem vorhandenen Rad unterscheiden. Vor der Bestellung entscheiden weiterhin die genaue Rahmenzeichnung und die Tabelle unten; Lagerschalen sollten nicht auf Verdacht ausgebaut werden – Park Tool warnt selbst, dass eine Fehleinschätzung den Rahmen beschädigen kann.

context.en: Park Tool's video follows the same order as this guide: check wheel seating, rotor, hub and pistons before moving the caliper, then align it. It is general hydraulic-brake education; your brake's own instructions and torque values still apply, and mount facing is a workshop decision, especially on a carbon frame.
context.zh-Hans: Park Tool的视频与本指南的顺序一致：先检查车轮安装、碟片、花鼓和活塞，再移动卡钳并对正。它属于液压碟刹的通用教学；你的刹车仍应遵循其自身说明书和扭矩值，而碟刹座面的修整应由车行决定，碳纤维车架尤其如此。
context.de: Das Park-Tool-Video folgt derselben Reihenfolge wie dieser Ratgeber: erst Radsitz, Bremsscheibe, Nabe und Kolben prüfen, dann den Bremssattel ausrichten. Es ist allgemeines Wissen zu hydraulischen Bremsen; die Anleitung und Anzugsmomente deiner Bremse gelten weiter, und das Planfräsen der Aufnahmen entscheidet die Werkstatt – besonders bei einem Carbonrahmen.

context.en: Park Tool's 2016 demonstration shows what a conversion involves and where it is limited: tubeless-ready rims and tyres are the ideal, there is no universal fit standard, and sealing can take days. It is not approval for converting an unapproved rim or tyre; follow your wheel and tyre makers' compatibility and installation instructions.
context.zh-Hans: Park Tool这段2016年的演示说明了改装真空胎涉及哪些步骤及其限制：最好使用标明支持真空胎的轮圈和轮胎，业内没有统一的配合标准，完全密封可能需要数天。它不代表可以改装未获认可的轮圈或轮胎；请遵循轮组和轮胎厂商的兼容性与安装说明。
context.de: Die Park-Tool-Vorführung von 2016 zeigt, was eine Umrüstung umfasst und wo ihre Grenzen liegen: Ideal sind Tubeless-Ready-Felgen und -Reifen, einen einheitlichen Passungsstandard gibt es nicht, und das Abdichten kann Tage dauern. Sie ist keine Freigabe, eine nicht zugelassene Felge oder einen Reifen umzurüsten; folge den Kompatibilitäts- und Montagehinweisen der Laufrad- und Reifenhersteller.
